blurb: Covenant Ballet Theatre of Brooklyn provides ballet classes for children, youth, teens, and adults, including a 10-month academy program following the American Ballet Theatre National Training Curriculum. They offer summer intensive programs, open enrollment classes for adults and teens, and studio rentals. The studio is located in South Brooklyn and features two dance studios with sound systems and climate control.
extraNote: Studio requests must be submitted by Thursday at 4pm for the following week · Payment must be made in full prior to the start of the studio rental · $25 registration fee required for all first-time participants in open enrollment classes · Entrance on Van Sicklen Street
